summary: Moderation resolution reads through transaction-scoped repositories and conditionally updates the observed OPEN/IN_REVIEW state; stale writes return typed HTTP 409 and cannot create a second terminal audit.
Strict runtime schemas guard posting creation/decisions, moderation inputs and saved-search create/update, with parsed values used for writes and server-owned identity preserved.
Posting and moderation pagination now include a deterministic ID tie-break; the Next generated type import matches production build output.
Expanded the complete suite to 20 passing tests, including synchronized competing reads, rollback-fixture orchestration and actual Prisma predicate/HTTP mapping assertions.
Replaced mismatched course chapters with nine source-based guides and a new root README, with complete exercises/solutions and explicit database-test limitations.
